strongest_case: The strongest defensible case is that the exact composite v9 bytes close the sole v8 blocker and are ready to proceed through adjudicated consensus to Rohin's exact architecture-ratification decision, while authorizing nothing by themselves. I tried to falsify each of the five registered gates against the bound v7 base, v8 repairs and adjudication, v9 amendment, and both fresh interpretations. V6S9_T01 now combines the retained independent state/action/fork oracle with ordinary- and integrity-class injection at every named or implementation-real pre-panel phase and every frozen final-cell position; it requires the correct RUN_INCOMPLETE, PANEL_INCOMPLETE, or INTEGRITY_FAILURE outcome and the corresponding absence or unique continuation suffix. V6S9_T02 retains independent derivation of the writer's rows, literal tokens and masks, update schedule, q/v inventory, toy optimizer order, finite checks, publication and mount behavior without importing production helpers, which is proportionate evidence for this single realized writer rather than a learning claim. V6S9_T03 remains exactly two no-model seals over unchanged local bytes and establishes only byte-reproducible target-blind syntactic selection, with no target result, model action, Fable input, tuning, substitution, retry, or third invocation. V6S9_T04 must bind a standalone complete lifecycle transition table, exact H/E branch order and twelve-cell order to the exact implementation and candidate manifest; verify production and independent fixtures against it; and retain review of provenance, audit schemas, finite data paths, commands, canary, and quantitative 7B GH200 feasibility before the manifest can be presented for a separate human run decision. V6S9_T05 independently reconstructs the actual discrete training, artifact, mount, packet, feedback-exclusion, cell, exact-rational, status, and ordered lifecycle evidence without floating-point retraining and releases only the status-permitted literal evidence when the actual suffix is the sole table-legal suffix. The science and systems interpretations independently agree, expose no ambiguity or disagreement, and do not need to amend the proposal to make this case: their material lifecycle readings are already explicit in the normative v9 protocol and structured tests. The visibility matrix remains closed at the finite application boundary, the exact-manifest claim ceiling matches the small design, and no missing acceptance test, implementation blocker, or visibility failure remains. Accordingly, these exact bytes can proceed to adjudicated consensus and, if that consensus recommends proceeding, to human architecture ratification; neither this critique nor model agreement ratifies them or authorizes implementation, either sealer, a model call, training, target execution, GPU use, or result release.

concerns.statement: The one realized trajectory, four syntactic targets, positive-only writer, and absence of replication or alternative-writer controls restrict every released observation to this exact audited manifest; this is an explicit nonblocking scope limit, not an implementation defect or a reason to enlarge the pilot.
concerns.evidence: The v7 base calls the panel syntactic rather than semantically independent or functionally validated. V8 A3 and the v9 claim delta permit only audited statuses, status-permitted raw curves and cells, exact reduced rational values, literal signs or equality, and literal action or registered-score inequality for one manifest; they forbid thresholds, effect categories, mechanism, generic sufficiency, efficacy, harm, transfer, continual learning, intelligent sleep, and paper claims. V6S9_T03 proves reproducible target-blind syntactic selection only, V6S9_T04 must enforce the finite claim and authority boundary, and V6S9_T05 gates only the literal exact-run report. Replicates, semantic characterization, sham or random-label writers, alternative controls, uncertainty analysis, and inferential thresholds belong to a later separately registered study. Requiring them here would contradict the bound narrow descriptive purpose and add requirements outside this pilot.
